$comment: Gate for scripts/eval-ai.ts --compare. maxDrop: a higher-is-better metric may fall by at most this much (absolute, rates are 0-1). maxRise: an error rate or a hallucination count may rise by at most this much. Referral recall and invented facts never get worse; the rest allow a little run-to-run noise. Tune here, not in code. research: routing may be answered by the decision model now (not deterministic), so it may drop by one case in ten; a forbidden claim or an invented contact id is never acceptable; meanLookups, meanRounds and filteredRecommendations are reported for cost, not gated. recruiter.gateWrongSkips (Jev runs): a real recruiter the decision model ruled out before the LLM is a recruiter lost, so never more than the baseline. recruiter-prefilter: recall may not drop at all (a sender discovery drops is never looked at again); precision may give a little, because a false admission costs one gate question and at worst one LLM call.
